spans.s:
mfn. (-वान्-भूषी-वः)
Been, become.
E.
भू to be, वसु aff.

r. 1st cl. (बभ्रति)
To go; also वभ्र.

f. (-वी)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
बभ्रु ŚIVA, and ङीप् aff.

f. (-वी)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
बभ्रु ŚIVA, with अण् and ङीप् added.

mfn. (-भ्रिः-भ्रिः-भ्रि)
Who or what has, holds, possesses, &c.
E.
भृ to cherish, किन् aff.

mfn. (-भ्रुः-भ्रुः or भ्रूः-भ्रु)
1 Large, great.
2 Tawny, &c.
3 Baldheaded through disease.
m. (-भ्रुः)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

AGNI or fire.
4 A large ichneumon.
5 The name of a Muni or holy sage.
6 A rat.
n. (-भ्रु)
1 A tawny or brown colour.
2 Any object of that colour.
E.
भृ to fill, aff. कु, and the initial repeated.
